gateRules: LLM/Codex output is candidate content only.
PendingReview, Rejected, and Deferred Requirements cannot generate tasks.
Tasks must bind RequirementId and RequirementVersionId.
Symphony Markdown exports only tasks derived from Approved Requirements.
ModelRun is represented in diagnostics panels, not as a standalone page.
knownRisks: The review action area screenshot has minor truncation risk; implementation must show Approve, ApproveWithAssumptions, RequestClarification, Reject, and Defer in full.
The export screen title includes '(修正布局)' because this is the retained corrected layout in Stitch.
Prototype counts are illustrative; key object IDs, states, and Gate rules are the facts to preserve.
